# Arnav Rastogi

> Arnav Rastogi is an AI researcher and engineer studying Applied AI and Data Science at IIT Jodhpur (BS, 2025–2029) alongside MITx's MicroMasters in Statistics and Data Science. He works on reinforcement learning, state space models, transformer internals, and agentic AI, and writes up his experiments on this site. His long-term goal is AI/ML research at the PhD level.

## Background

- Education: IIT Jodhpur, BS in Applied AI and Data Science (2025–2029); MITx MicroMasters in Statistics and Data Science (2024–present)
- Experience: AI Engineer Intern, Hapticware Intelligence (Mar–Jun 2026); Research Intern, Abhay Travels (Feb–Mar 2025)
- Founder of R2GI
- Interests: reinforcement learning, cellular automata, state space models, general-purpose AI agents
- Outside research: competitive football (national U-18 level), PADI Advanced Open Water diver

## Blog

- [One Architecture a Day](https://arnav.rastogi.net.in/blog/2026/one-architecture-a-day/): A series implementing major LLM architectures from scratch at mini scale under one shared harness, data, and token budget, October 2026
- [Can Mamba Learn, Unlearn, and Retain Noise?](https://arnav.rastogi.net.in/blog/2026/mamba-noise-learning-unlearning/): Extends a small-language-model noise study to Mamba state space models, February 2026
- [Multi-Hop Reasoning in Transformers](https://arnav.rastogi.net.in/blog/2026/multi-hop-reasoning-transformers/): How transformers handle multi-step reasoning, January 2026
- [ReLU vs GELU](https://arnav.rastogi.net.in/blog/2026/relu-vs-gelu/): How activation curvature affects transformer training stability, January 2026
